summary: Admin chart editor formatting updates for gross scores and scoring inputs.

existing_features.title: Update the Admin Callaway chart editor UI to use a fixed grid layout of 13 rows by 5 columns for gross-score chart entry, replacing the current variable-length row list table.

For each of the 5 gross-score columns in the chart editor grid, add an 'Adjustment' input row that applies to all gross-score cells in that same column, and ensure this per-column adjustment is saved/loaded alongside the chart data.
Allow 'worst holes' values in the chart editor to be entered and persisted in increments of 0.5, and update Callaway calculation logic to correctly handle half-hole deductions.

Update chart persistence and loading to be backward compatible with any previously saved row-based edited charts in localStorage, so the app can still load without errors after this chart format change.

new_feature_requests.summary: Format the admin chart editor to have 13 rows and 5 columns for gross scores.
Add a per-column adjustments row that applies to all scores in the corresponding gross score column.
Allow 'worst holes' to be entered in increments of 0.5.

projectName: Restructure Callaway chart editor into a 13x5 gross-score grid with per-column adjustments and 0.5 worst-hole increments
